name: Karnataka Post-Matric Scholarship
full_name: Post-Matric Scholarship for SC/ST/OBC Students - Karnataka
department: Social Welfare Department, Government of Karnataka
description: Financial assistance for SC, ST, and OBC students pursuing post-matric education in Karnataka

eligibility_rules.description: Applicant must be a permanent resident of Karnataka
Applicant must belong to SC, ST, or OBC category
Annual family income must not exceed ₹2,50,000 for SC/ST categories
Annual family income must not exceed ₹2,50,000 for OBC Category-1
Annual family income must not exceed ₹1,00,000 for OBC Category 2A/2B/3A/3B
Student must be pursuing post-matric education (Class 11 and above)
Student must be enrolled in a recognized educational institution
Bank account must be Aadhaar-seeded and NPCI-mapped for DBT

required_documents.name: Aadhaar Card
required_documents.description: Student's Aadhaar card with name matching exactly

required_documents.name: Caste/Community Certificate
required_documents.description: Valid caste certificate issued by Revenue Department with RD number

required_documents.name: Income Certificate
required_documents.description: Income certificate issued by Revenue Department with valid RD number

required_documents.name: SSLC Marksheet / SATS Registration
required_documents.description: SSLC marksheet or SATS registration number for academic verification

required_documents.name: Previous Year Marksheet
required_documents.description: Mark sheet of the last qualifying examination passed

required_documents.name: College Admission / Fee Receipt
required_documents.description: Current institution admission letter, fee receipt, or bonafide certificate

required_documents.name: Bank Passbook / Statement
required_documents.description: Bank passbook showing Aadhaar-linked account details

required_documents.name: Hostel Certificate
required_documents.description: Required only for hostel maintenance allowance claims

benefits.maintenance_allowance: Monthly maintenance allowance for day scholars and hostellers
benefits.other: Book allowance and other incidental charges as applicable

application_deadline: Typically December-January each academic year (check SSP portal for current dates)
renewal_requirements: Must pass the previous year's examination
Must maintain minimum attendance as per institution norms
Income certificate must be renewed annually
Re-verification through SSP portal each academic year
disqualification_conditions: Providing false information or forged certificates
Failing the previous year's examination (renewal applicants)
Family income exceeding the prescribed limit
Not being a domicile of Karnataka
Already receiving another scholarship for the same purpose
verification_note: Scheme details compiled from publicly available government sources. Applicants should verify current eligibility criteria and deadlines directly from the official SSP Karnataka portal.
